lessons.issue: Tools returned empty results for LiteratureHunter: search_openalex_sync, search_scopus_sync
lessons.resolution: When LiteratureHunter gets empty results from search_openalex_sync, search_scopus_sync, try: (1) simplify the search query, (2) use broader keywords, (3) check if the tool requires specific parameters.
